heading: Wave 11: ESI reads, owner-sync and owner-dataset persistence

briefs.focus: next 16.3.4 as installed, with cacheComponents: true (next.config.ts:18). Cover revalidateTag(tag, 'max') against revalidateTag(tag, { expire: 0 }); why updateTag is unavailable here (Server Actions only, and this repo writes from route handlers, after() and crons); the cacheTag and cacheLife 'minutes'/'hours' profiles under 'use cache'; and whether revalidateTag throws outside a request store (purge orchestrator, scripts, tests). Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/{revalidateTag,updateTag,cacheTag,cacheLife,after}.md and 01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md first. Confirm them against node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/cache-handlers/default.js, server/use-cache/use-cache-wrapper.js and server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js. briefs.tech: Drizzle ORM 0.45 on postgres-js and Neon HTTP
briefs.focus: drizzle-orm 0.45.2 over postgres-js 3.4.9 (directDatabase) and neon-http (@neondatabase/serverless 1.1.0, the default db). Cover which driver supports interactive db.transaction and row locks; insert().onConflictDoUpdate().returning(), and what the returned row holds when the update keeps an existing column (P273's tri-state taxPct); inArray with an empty list; how 0.45 wraps driver errors (the DrizzleQueryError cause chain), so isUniqueViolation still matches inside and outside a transaction; and the 65,534 bind-parameter limit for multi-row inserts. Read these first: src/db/index.ts, src/db/direct-database.ts, src/db/locked-user.ts, src/db/pg-errors.ts, src/lib/db-types.ts, src/features/owned-blueprints/queries.ts (the reference lock-first transaction), listCorpStructureSyncStates in src/features/owned-structures/queries.ts, and src/db/__tests__/support/db-test-harness.ts. Take signatures from the type definitions in node_modules/drizzle-orm, not from memory.

briefs.tech: Fetch API and ESI headers (Node 22 and the Convex isolate)
briefs.focus:
The Fetch API as esiFetch uses it in Node 22.22 and in the Convex default runtime. Cover:
- Headers.get case-insensitivity.
- Whether a RequestInit with plain-object headers and an optional signal survives esiFetch unchanged. structure-search.test.ts reads init.headers.Authorization.
- AbortSignal.throwIfAborted and the AbortError DOMException shape.
- Date.parse on IMF-fixdate Expires values, and Number.parseInt prefix parsing.
- ESI's X-Pages, Expires, Retry-After and X-ESI-Error-Limit-* headers.

Read src/platform/esi/dispatch.ts, src/platform/esi/authed-read.ts, src/platform/esi/scoreboard/keys.ts, src/data/market-prices/source.ts, src/data/market-history/source.ts and src/lib/server-only-boundary.test.ts first; src/platform/esi is a server-only root shared with Convex. Confirm that convex/characterLocationSync.ts can import a dependency-free '@/platform/esi/paths' in the non-Node runtime, as it already imports '@/platform/esi/authed-read'.

waveCautions: P190, P345, P189, P194 and P297 all edit composition/sync/owner-sync-port.ts. Land them strictly in table order, one PR at a time. P190 already deletes RefreshCorpMember and LinkedCharacterHealth, so P345 lands only its test fixtures. P193 owns the search-loop extraction (the README calls it firstScopedSearch). P150 only aligns the routes. It forwards request.signal only once aborts stop counting as failures. P189 and P292 share one module, src/lib/memoize.ts (singleFlight plus memoizeAsync). Never single-flight inside getFreshAccessTokenForCharacter. Writer chain: P336, then P239 (import P220's directDatabase), P184, P241 (uses expireNow and needs wave 10's P240, not started yet), then P273 (no rig-save revalidate). P286 lands before P178. P178's model, listCorpStructureSyncStates, now returns an array, not a Map. The export list in P184 step 5 goes stale once P286 lands. New platform/esi files must import nothing: the Convex isolate shares them, platform/esi is a server-only root, and features cannot import platform/esi. P194 touches convex/characterLocationSync.ts but changes no Convex exports, so no codegen is needed. Behaviour changes that need red-to-green tests: P193/P150, P184, P239, P297 and P241. P239 and P189 need real Postgres; skipped db tests are not green. Line numbers have drifted (dispatch.ts parseIntHeader is now at line 100). Notes left by earlier waves: ESI owner types live in platform/owner-sync (P258), scope eligibility in src/lib/scope-eligibility.ts and scopeHolderOf in scope-health (P186), and EVE scopes in src/config/eve-scopes.ts typed as EveScope (P187).
